data.one_liner: Supabase BaaS integration for Flutter chat applications with optional UI support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete chat backend using Supabase, PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, and Realtime broadcasts. Includes room management, messages with media, read receipts, reactions, and an optional chat UI controller.
use_when: You are building a chat or messaging feature using Supabase as your backend.
You need real-time messaging, typing indicators, and room management out of the box.
You want support for pagination, read receipts, and message attachments over PostgreSQL RLS.
avoid_when: You are using Firebase instead of Supabase as your backend.
You are not using Supabase or Postgres for your database needs.
strengths: Realtime sync over private Broadcast channels and Presence.
Secure by default with PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS).
Optimistic sending with retry support and cursor-based pagination.
Supports group management, roles, and Telegram-like chat features.
weaknesses: Requires running specific SQL scripts and database extensions (pg_partman, pg_cron) on Supabase.
Requires careful evaluation before integrating into large-scale projects.
Migration from 1.x requires a maintenance window and database schema updates.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing Supabase, running a sequence of custom SQL scripts on your Supabase database, and exposing the chats schema.
